comment: Independent C witness for music.c improvised_notes() leaving the bytes after a shorter tune's NUL. The fourth improvised flute tune has five notes, the next two three, and the seventh one ("E"), so svc.context.jingle holds E, NUL, a stale note, NUL, the first five-note tune's last note E, NUL. A wished magic portal keeps maketrap()'s dst of {-1, -1}; svd.dungeons[-1].depth_start overlays jingle[4..5] plus padding, so after the hero steps back onto the portal the status line's depth() of dungeon -1 is 'E' (69) - 1 - 1 = 67, not -2. Input stops at builds_up()'s impossible(), before mklev() makes the level. Seed, date, role and inputs chosen independently.
